description: Defines the CurrencyField class which handles currency formatting, conversion, and display within the vTiger CRM system. Includes methods for initializing currency settings, formatting currency values according to user preferences, and converting between database and user display formats.

classes.name: CurrencyField
classes.description: A class for managing currency formatting, conversion, and display in vTiger CRM, including user-specific settings.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes user's currency preferences including grouping pattern, separator, and currency details.

methods.name: setNumberofDecimals
methods.description: Sets the number of decimal places for currency formatting.

methods.name: convertToUserFormat
methods.description: Static method to format a value into the user's currency display format.

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Converts the value into a currency string based on user preferences, optionally skipping conversion.

methods.name: getDisplayValueWithSymbol
methods.description: Returns the formatted currency value with currency symbol appended.

methods.name: appendCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Static method to append currency symbol to a value with preferred placement.

methods.name: _formatCurrencyValue
methods.description: Formats the numeric value according to the configured currency pattern, separators, and decimal settings.

methods.name: getDBInsertedValue
methods.description: Returns the numeric value suitable for database storage, converting and stripping formatting.

methods.name: convertToDBFormat
methods.description: Static method to convert a formatted currency string into database numeric format.

methods.name: getDBCurrencyId
methods.description: Fetches the default system currency ID from the database.
